title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.23
subtitle: Native fluid coupling and larger FLIP caches.

highlights.title: GAIA 0.26 available
highlights.description: Download the official Windows GAIA 0.26 solver in Manage for experimental native FLIP-to-cloth coupling. Your selected solver stays unchanged.

highlights.title: A clearer fluid workflow
highlights.description: Separate Fluid Source, Cloth Response and Fluid Cache sections guide setup. Enable FLIP velocity export directly beside the domain and prepare your .gaia cache.

highlights.title: Large particle caches
highlights.description: Fluid preparation reads all particles in bounded blocks. A scene with 23,356 cloth vertices completed a native 250-frame test; existing memory and payload limits remain in place.
